instruction: There are three red cups on the table in front of you. Two of them have something under them: one has a pear and one has a ball. The third has nothing under it. Find the cup that has the pear, and put the pear under the cup that has nothing in it. Then call r.finish() with a short summary.

model_reasoning_effort = "medium"
model_reasoning_summary = "none"
service_tier = "ultrafast"
approval_policy = "never"
sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"
web_search = "disabled"

[features]
apps = false
plugins = false
remote_plugin = false
browser_use = false
browser_use_external = false
in_app_browser = false
computer_use = false
image_generation = false
daemon_auto_start = false
tool_suggest = false
memories = false

[skills]
include_instructions = false

[shell_environment_policy]
inherit = "all"
exclude = ["HTTPS_PROXY", "HTTP_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "https_proxy", "http_proxy", "all_proxy"]

notes: released the operator's park before the episode (--release-park)

finished.summary: Found the pear under the right cup and the middle cup empty. Moved the pear to the middle position and covered it with that previously empty cup. Verified the cup settled on the table and withdrew both grippers; the ball remains under its original cup.

check.rule: the ball seen by neither camera, the cup's top over 10 cm (standing); the operator confirms the ball is in the cup and not elsewhere
